title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: ICSP contributed to food and nutrition security by supporting vulnerable households with targeted interventions designed to mitigate extreme market disruption and food shortages. Twelve NIPP circles provided behaviour‑change support and food assistance to 1,080 participants, helping families improve feeding and hygiene practices despite limited food availability. However, acceptable Food Consumption Scores remained low due to continued blockade conditions. Preparedness for food‑related hazards advanced through community‑level contingency planning and training on risk identification and early action, enabling residents to better anticipate and respond to shocks even as livelihoods deteriorated.. The conflict in Sudan has deepened food shortages, disrupted markets and compounded the impacts of climate‑related stressors. GOAL’s ICSP supports communities to strengthen their nutrition security through NIPP‑based behaviour change and targeted support that help families maintain safer feeding and hygiene practices even under extreme scarcity.
